summary: A heavy-lift twin-rotor (tandem) transport helicopter: a long lofted rounded-box fuselage with a glazed nose… joints ramp, rotor_front, rotor_rear; sockets seat_driver, seat_pax_1, eye_point, cargo_hook, ramp_entry.
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.tandem_rotor_helicopter or place "prefab": "tandem_rotor_helicopter" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d().
